# Sloow

> Sloow is a mobile app for anxiety and depression that guides breathing at 0.1 Hz — the baroreflex resonance frequency — via binaural audio. No conscious effort required: the sound automatically entrains the user's breathing to 6 cycles per minute, maximizing heart rate variability (HRV) and activating the parasympathetic nervous system.

## What Sloow does

- Plays a precisely calibrated binaural audio signal at 0.1 Hz
- The sound guides breathing to baroreflex resonance without instruction or concentration
- Sessions last 20 minutes; physiological effects are measurable from session 1 via finger-PPG (RMSSD, SDNN, HF, LF metrics)
- Protocol: 20 sessions over 20 days — 10 days at 0.1 Hz baroreflex resonance, then 10 days at 0.033 Hz sub-VLF

## Science

Baroreflex resonance breathing (Vaschillo et al., Lehrer et al.) occurs at ~0.1 Hz / 6 breaths per minute, where heart rate variability peaks due to synchronization with the baroreceptor reflex. Clinical research shows 30–40% reduction in anxiety scores after 4 weeks of HRV biofeedback at this frequency.

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759012190
